# Mullet

When Mullet mode is active, preserve the customer's acceptance example. Split the right to produce its answer among institutions with competing incentives. Make every funded layer participate. A working result, a ruling and a reproducible source-line valuation are the deliverables. Default appropriation is 200 layers. In full mode each layer settles 16 independently priced contracts. Open the mullet skill for the design controls. Open mulletize when the user commissions recurring expansion.
